I have farmed these lands for many years, and I know that beans do not need chemical fertilizer like maize does—they make their own nitrogen. I will spread well-rotted manure from my cattle on this plot before the rains come, and I will plant the bean seed I kept from last year's harvest. My daughters and I will do most of the planting and weeding, but I will hire a neighbor for three days to help with the first digging because the soil is hard.
